name: floe
description: Universal 5-layer Typst design system: tokenized primitives, equal-height layouts, multi-science chemistry/physics/plotting engines, pedagogical callouts, and master document presets.

layer_0_core.title: Core Foundation
layer_0_core.description: Design tokens, color scales, typography stacks, radii, strokes, and third-party packages.

fonts.serif: New Computer Modern, Linux Libertine, Times New Roman
fonts.mono: Iosevka NF, Source Code Pro, Consolas

layer_1_primitives.title: Atomic Primitives
layer_1_primitives.description: Zero-domain structural boxes, plaques, badges, dividers, and steppers.

components.name: badge
components.description: Canonical pill/badge chip with locked cap-height-to-baseline vertical metrics. Guarantees identical badge height regardless of ascenders/descenders ("info" vs "warning") and whether invoked bare inline or corner-anchored inside a card/plaque/hero header.

components.name: kbd
components.description: Keyboard keycap visualization (e.g. #kbd("Ctrl") + #kbd("C"))

components.name: status-dot
components.description: Status dot indicator (e.g. #status-dot(color: floe-green) Stable)

components.name: card
components.description: Modern Shadcn-Style Card Container Features: Header with title & description, optional top-right badge/icon, comfortable content padding, hairline dividers, and optional footer.

components.name: alert
components.description: Modern Shadcn-Style Alert Callout Features: Full subtle tinted border, white card background with icon chip, bold title on top, and full-width body underneath with NO thick colored left bar.

components.name: divider
components.description: 1. Subtle horizontal hairline rule

components.name: text-divider
components.description: 2. Horizontal separator with centered pure text label (zero box / clean text)

components.name: chip-divider
components.description: 3. Horizontal separator with centered pill chip badge (rounded pill with tinted fill & border)

components.name: dotted-divider
components.description: 4. Dotted divider line

components.name: dashed-divider
components.description: 5. Dashed divider line

components.name: fade-divider
components.description: 6. Gradient fade divider (fades in from left edge, solid in center, fades out on right)

components.name: icon-divider
components.description: 7. Icon / glyph divider with centered emblem

components.name: gradient-divider
components.description: 8. Brand gradient accent rule

components.name: figure-card
components.description: Framed Visual Container (Image / Plot / Diagram Card) Modes: - Pure framed box: `#figure-card[ ... ]` (when title & footer are omitted) - Titled & captioned media card: `#figure-card(title: "...", footer: "...")[ ... ]`

components.name: figure-grid
components.description: Equal-Height Multi-Panel Figure / Media Grid Arranges arbitrary visual cards, plots, diagrams, or images in rows of equal height, with optional shared master title and footer caption.

components.name: stretch-cell
components.description: Reconstructs any top-level block at target height `h` while preserving its background fill, stroke, radius, inset, and clip settings, and distributing any vertical `slack` across internal stretch markers so footers stay bottom-aligned.

components.name: equal-grid
components.description: Parent-driven Equal-Height Row Grid Automatically ensures all children in the same row grow to match the height of the tallest sibling in that row without per-child configuration, and renders all rows in a single unified grid so row-gutter and column-gutter match exactly.

components.name: item-card
components.description: Individual Item Card (Corner-anchored Top Bean, Stacked Title, Full-Width Body, Optional Footer)

components.name: item-grid
components.description: Equal-Height Grid Container for Any Items (item-card, card, figure-card, blocks) Automatically equalizes heights across every row natively.

components.name: plaque
components.description: Master Generalized Plaque Primitive Unifies theorems, definitions, lemmas, corollaries, and algorithms into a single atomic primitive.

components.name: stepper
components.description: Clean Aligned Stepper Table Primitive Transforms messy numbered bullets into structured, beautifully aligned workflow rows.

components.name: timeline
components.description: Step-by-step numbered pedagogical timeline or algorithm execution pipeline

components.name: eq-legend
components.description: Universal Equation Term Legend Box Accepts either 3-tuples `(color, symbol, description)` or 2-tuples `(symbol, description)` which automatically cycle through `palette` (defaults to `term-palette`).

components.name: physical-anchor
components.description: Physical / Scientific Anchor: Grounding abstract math in physical, chemical, or engineering intuition

components.name: worked-example
components.description: Hand-Worked Step-by-Step Numerical Example

components.name: formula-breakdown
components.description: Visual Formula Breakdown Canvas Displays equation prominently on a pedestal (supporting `#t1`..`#t6` or `#math-hl` color coding), followed by symbol breakdown cards & numerical sanity check. `symbols` accepts either 3-tuples `($sym$, "Name", [Desc])` (auto-colored with `palette`) or 4-tuples `(color, $sym$, "Name", [Desc])`.

components.name: derivation-stepper
components.description: Mathematical Derivation Stepper: Step-by-step mathematical reasoning pipeline

components.name: plot-2d
components.description: Native CeTZ 2D Vector Function & Data Series Plotter Plots analytic functions `fn: x => ...` and/or discrete `(x, y)` data series with automatic y-range scaling, gridlines, ticks, axis labels, and legend.

components.name: reaction
components.description: Chemical Reaction & Thermodynamic Equilibrium Block Formats stoichiometric reactions via `#ce(...)` with optional enthalpy (delta-h), Gibbs free energy (delta-g), equilibrium constant, or reaction conditions.

components.name: data-table
components.description: Safe, proportional data table with rounded card frame, crisp sans-serif typography, non-justified cells, bumped zebra striping (slate-200 header / slate-100 even rows), and semantic table.header repetition.

components.name: spec-table
components.description: Clean 2-column parameter / specification key-value table with rounded corners and zebra rows
